target.title: fix(agents): resolve fable-5 1M context window for claude-cli provider
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When using `claude-cli` provider with `claude-fable-5`, the context window falls back to 200K instead of using fable-5's actual 1M capacity. The `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow` fable-5 guard only matched `anthropic` and `anthropic-vertex` providers, leaving `claude-cli` unhandled. Without this match, `claude-cli + claude-fable-5` fell through to the GA 1M prefix check where fable-5 doesn't match, returning `undefined` and causing fallback to the default 200K context window.

Relates to gap finding: `ctx-claude-cli-fable5-context-window` (manual-scan, evidence level A)
Location: `src/agents/context-resolution.ts:151`

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `provider === 'claude-cli'` to the fable-5 guard in `resolveAnthropicFixedContextWindow`, matching the pattern already used by the GA 1M guard on the next branch. This ensures all three Anthropic-affiliated providers (anthropic, anthropic-vertex, claude-cli) resolve fable-5's context window correctly.

Both call paths were affected:
- `resolveContextTokensForModelFromCache` (direct)
- `resolveDiscoveredAnthropicFixedContextWindow` (discovery cache upgrade)

Same root cause as #100572: new model added to catalog but claude-cli provider boundary was not enumerated.

## User Impact

Users running `claude-cli` provider with `claude-fable-5` model see reduced 200K context window instead of the full 1M. After this fix, `claude-cli + claude-fable-5` correctly resolves to 1M context tokens.

## Evidence

- `pnpm test src/agents/context.test.ts` — 55 passed (1 test file, 55 tests)
- Autoreview: clean
- PR review: clean — no findings

Behavior addressed: claude-cli + fable-5 context window resolution
Real environment tested: unit tests covering all claude-cli + fable-5 provider/model combinations
Exact steps or command run after this patch: `pnpm test src/agents/context.test.ts`
Evidence after fix: 55 tests passed, including new assertions for claude-cli + fable-5 in 4 test groups (discovery cache upgrade, direct resolution, authored override, fixed model override)
Observed result after fix: All 55 tests pass; `claude-cli/claude-fable-5` resolves to `ANTHROPIC_FABLE_CONTEXT_TOKENS` (1M)
What was not tested: Live gateway test is not needed — the fix is a targeted provider enum addition in a pure function with exhaustive unit test coverage
